m19.text: The Meditation Realm is the still-water realm where Ugin floated, and in Core Set 2019 Bolas tells Naiva his own version of what happened there, claiming that Ugin attacked him and that he killed Ugin purely in self-defense.

Ugin's own memories, which Naiva enters by taking Baishya's hand, tell a different story: Bolas attacks Ugin there, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge, and Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead.
Ugin accepts his death, Bolas kills him, and the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
The realm then refills, and a dragon reborn from the waters resolves to protect the planes and departs, while Bolas, as god-emperor, sets two gigantic curved horns over the realm to mark his triumph.
